description:
Create/rename/delete groups, change members/enablement or merge inventory; physical actions use control. Read IDs/etags first. Every batch reference to a group uses its starting etag. MOVE_MEMBER needs memberEndpointId plus source/target IDs and both etags. List order cannot resolve contradictory edits; adding does not implicitly move exclusive membership.

Native-capable changes default to BEST_EFFORT: provider change/readback precedes local intent; failure can fall back locally as PARTIALLY_APPLIED. PORTOS_ONLY sends nothing. FAIL_ON_PROVIDER_ERROR fails intent while retaining received provider facts. Native effects cannot roll back. NOT_DECLARED alone is not partial; OUTSIDE_PRINCIPAL prevents native changes through another principal. MERGE_INTO and aggregate/route enablement require PORTOS_ONLY.

Require explicit user authorization for exact MERGE_INTO/DELETE_GROUP targets/effects. Deletion may delete native groups; unretired routes stay disabled/orphaned against rediscovery. Route enablement needs its native etag and groupEtag when grouped. Use declared provider support; robot room edits do not reshape maps.

validateOnly=true authorizes/plans without sending/writing. Otherwise use a unique idempotencyKey per intent; identical retries retain it. Stale etag: reread/reconsider. Inspect batch status, per-item outcomes and providerDispatches, including on failure. Failed intent can retain provider changes; never claim full synchronization or automatically repeat native writes.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this intended change, at most 255 characters. Required unless validateOnly is true.

operations.description: Compatible intended changes in one customer batch. Reuse each group's starting etag across its references; contradictory edits cannot be resolved by list order.

items.description: One endpoint group management operation, discriminated by `operation`. Unknown operations are rejected with 400.

oneOf.description: Creates a user group. Its new ID and etag are returned in the result; later operations in the same batch cannot reference it. A user group name is `{"type": "PLAIN", "value": ...}` whose value is non-blank UTF-8 text of at most 256 bytes with no control characters; anything else is rejected with BAD_REQUEST. Each added member must be the ID of an existing endpoint the caller can read; a malformed ID is BAD_REQUEST, and a missing or unreadable endpoint is NOT_FOUND.

type.description: The type identifier of the name value, defined as plain when not defined.

value.description: the raw value of a plain name.

allOf.description: Provider synchronization policy. BEST_EFFORT asks declared providers first and saves local fallback intent on failure. FAIL_ON_PROVIDER_ERROR fails the customer batch on a failed supported dispatch while retaining received provider truth. PORTOS_ONLY changes local intent. Undeclared messages are reported as NOT_SUPPORTED and do not prevent local changes.
